content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

This is a self-owned commerce system that automates digital product delivery after crypto payment. It’s not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure. Here’s why it matters: When Stripe or PayPal reject your region, they don’t just block payments—they block your business. This stack replaces them. It uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhook triggers. The moment payment confirms on-chain, the ebook is delivered. No platform controls your pipeline. No subscriptions. No shutdown risk. You own the entire stack after deployment. This is infrastructure sovereignty—built for creators who refuse to rent their business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s the step-by-step flow: 1. Buyer visits your store hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. They select your ebook and pay in crypto via NOWPayments. 3. NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and fires a webhook. 4. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script receives the webhook, confirms payment, and generates a secure download link. 5. The buyer receives the link instantly via email or on-screen. 6. The order is logged in Supabase or Google Sheets for your records. File delivery happens via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The entire process is automated, secure, and runs without human intervention. No buyer account is required. No platform touches your data. The system is designed to handle spikes in traffic and low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON. This isn’t duct-taped SaaS—it’s a stack built for permanence.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and other payment processors are unavailable or severely restricted. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software, and your buyers can’t pay you through conventional platforms, this stack is for you. It’s also for creators who want full data ownership and control over their commerce pipeline. You’re not a victim—you’re someone who chose better architecture. This stack is pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are realities. It’s designed to work when everything else fails. If you’re tired of workarounds and want to own your infrastructure, this is your solution. No platform lock-in. No shutdown risk. Just sovereign commerce.
This stack is built for creators who refuse to rent their business.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack combines free and paid tools into a unified system: 1. **Hosting**: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages (free). 2. **Backend Logic**: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script (free). 3. **Order Storage**: Supabase or Google Sheets (free). 4. **File Delivery**: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 (free). 5. **Payment Processing**: NOWPayments (0.5% fee). Each component is chosen for reliability, cost, and ease of integration. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and requires no KYC. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script handle webhook logic and file delivery. Supabase and Google Sheets store order data securely. The stack is modular—you can swap components as needed. For example, use Cloudflare R2 instead of Google Drive for faster file delivery. The Complete Builder Kit includes all blueprints and templates to deploy this stack in 48 hours.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all 6 blueprints, 7 templates, and instant download access. If you prefer a done-for-you solution, choose the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Both are deployed in 48 hours with full support. Here’s what to expect: 1. **Sovereign Starter Stack**: GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments. 3 products loaded. 30-day support. 2. **Edge Commerce Stack**: Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments. 5 products loaded. SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured. End-to-end tested. 30-day support. 3. **Complete Builder Kit**: All blueprints, templates, and scaling playbook. Instant download. Whichever option you choose, you’ll own the stack after deployment. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. Just sovereign commerce infrastructure built for your business.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages (free) or Cloudflare Pages (free). 2. Set up backend logic: Cloudflare Workers (free) or Google Apps Script (free). 3. Configure order storage: Supabase (free) or Google Sheets (free). 4. Prepare file delivery: Google Drive (free) or Cloudflare R2 (free). 5. Integrate payment processing: NOWPayments (0.5% fee). 6. Test the webhook flow: Ensure payment confirmation triggers file delivery. 7. Load your products: Add ebooks, courses, or templates to the system. 8. Deploy the stack: Push code to GitHub or Cloudflare. 9. Test end-to-end: Simulate a purchase to verify delivery. 10. Launch your store: Share the link with your audience.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates and blueprints designed for non-developers. If you prefer, the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack are deployed for you in 48 hours with full support.
What cryptocurrencies can my buyers use?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended low-fee networks include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transactions under $0.10.
Do I need to pay recurring fees?
No. After deployment, you own the stack. There are no subscriptions or recurring fees. The only cost is NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction fee.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook. The stack is modular and can handle increased traffic and product volume.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
The stack is designed to work with any crypto payment processor. If NOWPayments fails, you can swap it with another provider without disrupting your system.
